scope: Cross-chain security/privacy proof for all 12 Batch 6 tasks

findings.area: No listening ports / no network activation
findings.evidence: None of the 12 new source files import node:net, node:http, node:https, node:dgram, or node:dns. The Offline Lessons implementation has a dedicated regression test asserting this via source-text grep against its own file. About Screen's runtime state privacy block reports networkActivation:false, derived from a real static field, not a claim disconnected from the code.

findings.area: No microphone/camera access in the Singy Kids slice
findings.evidence: getPrivacyManifest() in offline_lessons_implementation.mjs declares microphone:false and camera:false as literal fields, and no audio/video capture API is referenced anywhere in the module -- audio cues are one-way playback simulations only (AudioCue handles), never capture.

About Screen's runtime-state privacy.telemetry is always false in every test scenario (6 products x 2 entitlement states). Offline Lessons' getPrivacyManifest().telemetry is always false. Neither module contains any outbound reporting call.

findings.area: Parent-gate tamper resistance (no bypass via direct state edit)
findings.evidence: checkParentGate() and resetProgress() never read a persisted 'unlocked' boolean -- the only persisted parent-gate fields are failedAttempts and lockedUntil. The expected answer is always recomputed fresh from a seed via generateParentChallenge(), so editing progress.json cannot fabricate a passed gate. Proven by an explicit test: resetProgress() with a wrong answer always throws, regardless of prior progress state.
normalizeEvidencePaths() reuses Batch 4's real validateRelativePath and rejects absolute paths, '..' traversal, and Windows drive letters -- proven with 3 explicit malicious-path test cases.

The Commercial Acceptance Harness treats a technical-WAV-proves-musical-quality claim, an offline-render-proves-realtime-DSP claim, and a KORG-inspection-proves-write-support claim as critical FAIL conditions -- documentation can never manufacture proof the runtime evidence does not support.

note: No critical security or privacy findings surfaced across Batch 6's 12 new tasks. This is a scoped, evidence-backed check of the code written this batch -- it is not a full penetration test or a claim of comprehensive security coverage for the whole 1604-task program.
